description: Legacy look op: switch `preset`, patch v2-style `tokens` (colors, fonts, radius, hero layout, …) or set custom CSS. Prefer update_theme_settings / apply_style_preset.

custom_css.description: Extra CSS; null clears it. No @import, url() or <

preset.description: Style preset: terra | porto | noir | marche | slate

tokens.description: Merge patch on theme tokens: colors{primary,accent,bg,fg,primaryFg,card,muted,line,line2}, loyalty{bg,ink}, fonts{heading,body,mono}, radius, radiusButton, heroLayout, serif, density, headingCase, buttonStyle, reserveKind. null removes an override.

name: update_theme
title: Update theme
